scripts.e2e:device-list: bash -c 'pkill -f "vite.*5198" 2>/dev/null || true; WIDSCAN_E2E_MOCK=1 npx vite --port 5198 >/dev/null 2>&1 & VITE_PID=$!; sleep 3; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:5198/ | grep -q 200 || { echo "vite failed"; kill $VITE_PID; exit 1; }; node e2e/device-list.mjs --url http://localhost:5198/ "$@"; RC=$?; kill $VITE_PID; exit $RC' --
